records.title: Gate: treatment consistency STD-GATE-001: a display whose arm counts differ from the study model fails the gate, and the error names the display, the arm and both numbers (#59)
Gate: treatment consistency STD-GATE-002: two displays reporting the same analysis set with different counts in one document is an error naming both, even when one of them matches the model (#59)
Gate: treatment consistency STD-GATE-003: a display with no population record is a named warning, never a silent pass; one with no arm grouping is warned and not counted as checked (#59)
Gate: treatment consistency STD-GATE-004: an analysis set the model does not declare is an error, not a skipped check (#59)
Gate: treatment consistency STD-GATE-005: the committed report assembles green on the gate, every placed display is gated by arm, and none of them read the alternate lane (#60)
Study model STD-MODEL-001: library/study.yaml loads with three arms in print order and every analysis set counted per arm (#59)
Study model STD-MODEL-002: every assembly that declares treatment groups declares the model's arms, in the model's order (#59)
DSP-ALL-001: every display renders a table that actually contains numbers (#1)
DSP-ALL-002: every display declares a regulatory identifier and a source line (#1)
DSP-DEMO-001: the age summary matches the pilot's ADSL computed directly, and the display is the intent-to-treat population with a Total column (#61)
DSP-DEMO-002: sex, Race (Origin) and age-group counts and percentages match ADSL, printed the way the report prints them (#61)
DSP-DEMO-003: every p-value on the display is the one-way ANOVA or Pearson chi-square the report's footnote names, recomputed independently (#61)
DSP-DEMO-004: Race (Origin) is a stated recode of race and ethnicity, not a data conflict — 218 + 12 = 230 (#61)
STD-MODEL-003: the treatment vocabulary and the analysis-set registry resolve from the study model, not from code (#59)
STD-MODEL-004: every count the model declares is what the default lane's ADSL holds, per arm and per set (#59)
STD-MODEL-005: every committed ARD carries a population record that agrees with the study model for its analysis set (#59)
STD-SRC-001: the default registry serves every pilot dataset from the study's own package, and only the two datasets it lacks come from the alternate (#60)
STD-SRC-002: the pilot's ADVS prepares without derived-record or timepoint columns the alternate carries, and its series keys match (#60)
